args.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('textarea, [class*="json"]'); const text = el ? el.value : document.body.innerText; const m = text.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if (m) { try { const j = JSON.parse(m[0]); return JSON.stringify({uid: j.uid, title: j.title, tags: j.tags, time: j.time, refresh: j.refresh, panels: j.panels.map(p => ({title: p.title, type: p.type, datasource: p.datasource, content: p.content}))}); } catch(e) { return 'parse error: ' + e.message; } } return 'no json found'; })()

(() => { const el = document.querySelector('textarea'); if (!el) return 'no textarea'; const text = el.value; const start = text.indexOf('{'); const end = text.lastIndexOf('}'); if (start === -1 || end === -1) return 'no braces'; try { const j = JSON.parse(text.slice(start, end+1)); return JSON.stringify({uid: j.uid, title: j.title, tags: j.tags, time: j.time, refresh: j.refresh, panels: j.panels.map(p => ({title: p.title, type: p.type, datasource: p.datasource, content: p.content}))}); } catch(e) { return 'parse error: ' + e.message + ' | first 300 chars: ' + text.slice(0, 300); } })()

(() => { const el = document.querySelector('textarea'); if (!el) return 'no textarea'; const text = el.value; const out = {}; out.uid = (text.match(/"uid"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/g) || []).slice(0,5); out.title = text.match(/"title"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/g); out.tags = text.match(/"tags"\s*:\s*\[[^\]]*\]/g); out.refresh = text.match(/"refresh"\s*:\s*"[^"]*"/g); out.time = text.match(/"time"\s*:\s*\{[^}]*\}/g); out.datasource = text.match(/"datasource"\s*:\s*\{[^}]*\}/g); out.content = text.match(/"content"\s*:\s*"[^"]*"/g); out.type = text.match(/"type"\s*:\s*"[^"]*"/g); return JSON.stringify(out, null, 1); })()
